conceptZh: 慢是動作不快、一步一步來
object: a toy fire engine racing to put out a tiny fire, slowed down by a surprise snail
morph: a snail pops out of a toy box and the whole rescue slows down while the left heart-radical and right 曼 part of 慢 ease into place
creativeAngle: 消防車急著出動，卻從盒子裡蹦出一隻蝸牛擋路，全場被迫慢下來；急與慢的對比，詞用「慢吞吞」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale mint-white backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 慢, centered in saturated royal purple strokes, about 70 percent of frame height, with the vertical heart radical 忄 on the left and the wider 曼 part on the right. Cast: a chunky red toy fire engine named Siren with a wobbly siren light, and a fat green-shelled cartoon snail that lives in a gift box. Moment one, 0 to 1.7s: Siren zooms in from the left at top speed, lights spinning, braking in a skid beside a small yellow box tied with a bow. The first 慢 is spoken as the lid pops open. Moment two, 1.7 to 3.4s: the snail springs out of the box with a boing, lands right in the road, and Siren does a double-take, eyes bulging, nearly tipping onto its nose. The snail stretches its feelers and sets off across the floor at a gloriously slow crawl, and the heart radical 忄 slides up beside it one drop at a time. The second 慢 is spoken as the right side 曼 settles in behind it. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: Siren tries to squeeze past, bumps the shell, and ends up creeping behind the snail with its siren lazily turning, even its water hose drooping slowly like a sleepy elephant trunk. Moment four, 5.0s onward: the snail reaches a tiny finish ribbon at the edge of frame and Siren, still rolling at snail speed, finally arrives and breaks the ribbon with a gentle tap. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is completely still and clear while Siren and the snail sit side by side near the bottom, the snail slowly blinking and Siren swaying its siren light in a sleepy smile, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「慢、慢、慢吞吞」, slowly and distinctly as ㄇㄢˋ、ㄇㄢˋ、ㄇㄢˋ ㄊㄨㄣ ㄊㄨㄣ. First 慢 near 0.6s, second near 2.3s, and 慢吞吞 around 5.2s, stretched gently as the snail slides past. Stop after the word. Only a soft boing and quiet rolling sounds, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 慢.

conceptZh: 拉布拉多警長被豬探長用玩具大砲發射，卻以超級慢動作飄過天空、飛過積木塔、彈到彈簧牆再倒栽進水桶，撞得積木塔散落排成「慢」，最後警長頂著水桶慢慢地往前走。
object: a big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff loaded into a spring toy cannon, aimed at a tall tower of purple toy blocks
morph: the cannon fires him in absurd slow motion; he floats past the tower, bounces off a springy bumper and lands upside-down in a bucket, and the thud shakes the block tower loose so the blocks tumble and settle as the strokes of 慢, 忄 on the left and 曼 on the right
creativeAngle: 改用「發射」模式並把「慢」直接做成笑點：大砲明明轟隆發射，警長卻像氣球一樣慢慢飄，六歲孩子一眼就看懂「慢」的意思。撞擊本身把積木塔震散排成字，不再是蝸牛安靜爬行或零件自己拼合；最後警長頂著水桶慢慢走，正好配上「慢慢」的發音。
promptEn:
An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale mint-white backdrop, locked camera, soft studio lighting, bright but not neon. The only text in the whole clip is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 慢, which forms late in saturated royal purple blocks, centered, about 70 percent of frame height with clear margins: the narrow heart radical 忄 on the left, the taller 曼 on the right with 日 on top, 罒 in the middle and 又 at the bottom.

Lead: a big, bouncy cartoon Labrador sheriff dog, golden fur, a shiny star badge, a silver whistle, huge eager eyes, proud and overconfident. Supporting: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat, holding a magnifying glass far too big for him.

Moment one, 0 to 1.5s: on the left, a chunky red spring toy cannon with a big lever. The sheriff is already stuffed in the barrel, pointing dramatically across the frame at a tall tower of purple toy blocks on the right. He blows his whistle, strikes a stiff drumroll pose with paws up, and the pig charges in, grabs the lever and yanks it with his whole body.

Moment two, 1.5 to 3.2s: the cannon goes BOOM with a puff of smoke, but the sheriff drifts out of the barrel in ridiculous slow motion, floating up in a huge lazy arc like a balloon, legs pedaling, ears flapping gently, grin slowly turning to wide-eyed worry. The pig stares up through his giant magnifying glass. The first 慢 is spoken right here as the sheriff hangs in the air.

Moment three, 3.2 to 4.8s: the sheriff sails straight over the block tower, misses it completely, BOINGS off a big springy bumper at the far right edge, flips, and plops upside-down into a tin bucket with a heavy BONK, hind legs waving. The thud shakes the tower: the blocks wobble, tumble and slide in a clear clatter, landing one group at a time as the strokes of 慢, the two dots and the vertical of 忄 on the left first, then 日, 罒 and 又 stacking down the right. The second 慢 is spoken as the last block clicks into place.

Moment four, 4.8 to 8.0s: the glyph is completely still and readable for the final three seconds. Below the strokes, the sheriff, bucket still on his head, waddles forward at a dreamy snail pace, one tiny step at a time, tail wagging, while the pig tiptoes beside him just as slowly, both never touching the strokes. The word 慢慢 is spoken exactly as the sheriff takes his two slow, proud bucket-headed steps.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「慢、慢、慢慢」, read as ㄇㄢˋ、ㄇㄢˋ、ㄇㄢˋ ㄇㄢˋ, slowly and distinctly with clear tones, first 慢 near 2.0s, second near 4.6s, 慢慢 around 5.6s. Stop after the word. Only a soft boom, a stretched slow whoosh, a boing and a gentle bonk, no background music. No flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 慢.
